SELECT * FROM ASSET_CHANGE_RECORD
ORDER BY CHANGE_DATE DESC, CREATE_TIME DESC
LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{pageNumber}
OFFSET #{pageNumber} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{pageSize} ROWS ONLY
SELECT * FROM ASSET_CHANGE_RECORD WHERE ASSET_ID = #{assetId} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY CHANGE_DATE DESC
SELECT * FROM ASSET_CHANGE_RECORD WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY CHANGE_DATE DESC
SELECT * FROM ASSET_CHANGE_RECORD WHERE CHANGE_TYPE = #{changeType} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY CHANGE_DATE DESC
SELECT * FROM ASSET_CHANGE_RECORD WHERE CHANGE_REASON = #{changeReason} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY CHANGE_DATE DESC
SELECT * FROM ASSET_CHANGE_RECORD WHERE APPROVAL_STATUS = #{approvalStatus} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY CHANGE_DATE DESC
SELECT * FROM ASSET_CHANGE_RECORD WHERE WARNING_LEVEL = #{warningLevel} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY CHANGE_DATE DESC
SELECT * FROM ASSET_CHANGE_RECORD WHERE IS_MAJOR_CHANGE = #{isMajorChange} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY CHANGE_DATE DESC
SELECT * FROM ASSET_CHANGE_RECORD WHERE NEED_WARNING = #{needWarning} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY CHANGE_DATE DESC
SELECT * FROM ASSET_CHANGE_RECORD WHERE TRANSFEROR = #{transferor} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY CHANGE_DATE DESC
SELECT * FROM ASSET_CHANGE_RECORD WHERE TRANSFEREE = #{transferee} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY CHANGE_DATE DESC
SELECT * FROM ASSET_CHANGE_RECORD WHERE CHANGE_OPERATOR = #{changeOperator} AND DELETED = 0 ORDER BY CHANGE_DATE DESC

SELECT ASSET_ID as assetId, ASSET_NAME as assetName, COUNT(*) as changeCount, MAX(CHANGE_DATE) as lastChangeDate FROM ASSET_CHANGE_RECORD WHERE DELETED = 0 AND CHANGE_DATE >=
DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
SYSDATE - #{days}
GROUP BY ASSET_ID, ASSET_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= #{minChangeCount} ORDER BY changeCount DESC

SELECT CHANGE_ID as changeId, ASSET_ID as assetId, ASSET_NAME as assetName, CHANGE_TYPE as changeType, CHANGE_AMOUNT as changeAmount, BEFORE_VALUE as beforeValue, AFTER_VALUE as afterValue, CHANGE_IMPACT as changeImpact, RISK_ASSESSMENT_RESULT as riskAssessment, COMPLIANCE_CHECK_RESULT as complianceCheck FROM ASSET_CHANGE_RECORD WHERE CHANGE_ID = #{changeId} AND DELETED = 0

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(CHANGE_DATE, '%Y-%m') as changeMonth,
TO_CHAR(CHANGE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') as changeMonth,
COUNT(*) as acquisitionCount, SUM(CHANGE_AMOUNT) as totalAmount, AVG(CHANGE_AMOUNT) as avgAmount FROM ASSET_CHANGE_RECORD WHERE ENTERPRISE_ID = #{enterpriseId} AND DELETED = 0 AND CHANGE_TYPE = 'ACQUISITION'
AND CHANGE_DATE >= #{startDate}
AND CHANGE_DATE <= #{endDate}
GROUP BY
DATE_FORMAT(CHANGE_DATE, '%Y-%m')
TO_CHAR(CHANGE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY changeMonth

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(CHANGE_DATE, '%Y-%m') as changeMonth,
TO_CHAR(CHANGE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') as changeMonth,
COUNT(*) as changeCount, SUM(CHANGE_AMOUNT) as totalAmount, AVG(CHANGE_AMOUNT) as avgAmount FROM ASSET_CHANGE_RECORD WHERE DELETED = 0
AND CHANGE_DATE >= #{startDate}
AND CHANGE_DATE <= #{endDate}
GROUP BY
DATE_FORMAT(CHANGE_DATE, '%Y-%m')
TO_CHAR(CHANGE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM')
ORDER BY changeMonth

SELECT
DATE_FORMAT(CHANGE_DATE, '%Y-%m') as changeMonth,
TO_CHAR(CHANGE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM') as changeMonth,
CHANGE_TYPE as changeType, SUM(CHANGE_AMOUNT) as totalAmount, COUNT(*) as changeCount FROM ASSET_CHANGE_RECORD WHERE DELETED = 0
AND CHANGE_DATE >= #{startDate}
AND CHANGE_DATE <= #{endDate}
GROUP BY
DATE_FORMAT(CHANGE_DATE, '%Y-%m'),
TO_CHAR(CHANGE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM'),
CHANGE_TYPE ORDER BY changeMonth, changeType

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) as totalChanges, SUM(CHANGE_AMOUNT) as totalAmount, AVG(CHANGE_AMOUNT) as avgAmount, SUM(CASE WHEN IS_MAJOR_CHANGE = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as majorChangeCount, SUM(CASE WHEN NEED_WARNING = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as warningChangeCount, SUM(CASE WHEN APPROVAL_STATUS = 'PENDING' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pendingApprovalCount, SUM(CASE WHEN APPROVAL_STATUS = 'APPROVED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as approvedCount, SUM(CASE WHEN APPROVAL_STATUS = 'REJECTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as rejectedCount FROM ASSET_CHANGE_RECORD WHERE DELETED = 0
SELECT CHANGE_TYPE as type, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(CHANGE_AMOUNT) as amount FROM ASSET_CHANGE_RECORD WHERE DELETED = 0 GROUP BY CHANGE_TYPE ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT CHANGE_REASON as reason, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(CHANGE_AMOUNT) as amount FROM ASSET_CHANGE_RECORD WHERE DELETED = 0 GROUP BY CHANGE_REASON ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT APPROVAL_STATUS as status, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(CHANGE_AMOUNT) as amount FROM ASSET_CHANGE_RECORD WHERE DELETED = 0 GROUP BY APPROVAL_STATUS ORDER BY count DESC

SELECT WARNING_LEVEL as level, COUNT(*) as count, SUM(CHANGE_AMOUNT) as amount FROM ASSET_CHANGE_RECORD WHERE DELETED = 0 AND NEED_WARNING = 1 GROUP BY WARNING_LEVEL ORDER BY CASE WARNING_LEVEL WHEN 'CRITICAL' THEN 1 WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 2 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 3 WHEN 'LOW' THEN 4 ELSE 5 END

SELECT CHANGE_ID as changeId, ASSET_NAME as assetName, ENTERPRISE_NAME as enterpriseName, CHANGE_TYPE as changeType, CHANGE_REASON as changeReason, CHANGE_DATE as changeDate, CHANGE_AMOUNT as changeAmount, BEFORE_VALUE as beforeValue, AFTER_VALUE as afterValue, BEFORE_STATUS as beforeStatus, AFTER_STATUS as afterStatus, TRANSFEROR as transferor, TRANSFEREE as transferee, TRANSFER_PRICE as transferPrice, DISPOSAL_PRICE as disposalPrice, APPROVAL_STATUS as approvalStatus, APPROVAL_DATE as approvalDate, APPROVER as approver, IS_MAJOR_CHANGE as isMajorChange, NEED_WARNING as needWarning, WARNING_LEVEL as warningLevel, CHANGE_OPERATOR as changeOperator, CHANGE_DEPARTMENT as changeDepartment, CHANGE_DESCRIPTION as changeDescription, CREATE_TIME as createTime FROM ASSET_CHANGE_RECORD
ORDER BY CHANGE_DATE DESC, CREATE_TIME DESC
